title: Charles Martel defeats the Umayyads at the Battle of Tours
summary: Frankish forces under Charles Martel defeated an Umayyad army led by Abd al-Rahman al-Ghafiqi between Poitiers and Tours. The Umayyad commander was killed.
reason: After conquering Iberia, Umayyad armies were raiding north into Gaul, and this force was heading for the rich abbey of Tours.
significance: It halted the northward advance of the caliphate into Western Europe and raised the power of the Carolingian family.
